sentences.text: This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 is preferred being aggrieved by the award dated 07.11.2023 passed by First Additional MACT, Sardarpur, District Dhar in Claim Case MACC/42/2020 for enhancement of Rs.2,00,000/-.
2. Only quantum of compensation is involved in this appeal, accordingly, the facts are being stated briefly.

In an application under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicle Act, a compensation of Rs.4,79,000/-was awarded for the physical injuries caused in motor vehicle accident dated 06.10.2019 at 02:30 PM within the jurisdiction of Police Station Rajod, District Dhar.
3. This appeal is preferred on the ground that all the heads have been awarded at the lower side.

Permanent physical disability has been assessed ignoring the expert opinion of Doctor Devendra Mandloi (AW-3).
4.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
6. The counsel for the respondent opposed the prayer and submitted that awarded amount by the Tribunal is appropriate and proper.
No further NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:7399 2 MA-3016-2024 interference is required.
7. Perused the award and also Paragraph-40 of the award.
Tribunal has awarded the compensation assessing the permanent income Rs. 6,625/-, whereas a sum of Rs. 7,950/- per month be assessed.
The Tribunal has assessed only 20% permanent disability.
There was no reason to take a different view as expressed by Doctor Devendra Mandloi (AW-3).
Hence, the compensation ought to have been calculated treating the permanent disability as 25%.

On re-calculation, the compensation for Ratan vs Lalsingh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116923580/
1 loss of income comes to Rs. 5,34,240/-.
The Tribunal has assessed only Rs.3,56,160/-.
Hence, a sum of Rs. 2,05,231/- is further enhanced.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.

8. The appellant has valued the appeal only to the extent of Rs.2,00,000/-
and paid the Court fee accordingly.

However, for the remaining amount, the Court fee shall be paid by the appellant within a period of one month and thereafter the amount shall be released by the Insurance Company on receiving the certificate.

In case the certificate has not been filed before the Insurance Company up to a period of three months, the claimant shall not be entitled to receive the interest on the enhanced amount of compensation.
9. Accordingly, appeal is disposed of to the extent indicated herein above.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE rashmi Ratan vs Lalsingh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116923580/
